title: Rules of Hooks violation in MatchFlowWizard
description: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/match-flow-wizard.tsx:69 calls React.useCallback AFTER conditional early returns at lines 59-64. On the render where match first arrives, hook count changes and React throws 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' Fix: move advanceToResult above the early returns. Effort: 1 line.

title: Demo recorder broken: 7/12 scenes target hidden routes
description: Today's demo (alpha build, 2026-05-15) will appear broken. Per CLAUDE.md, /arena, /arena/swipe, /match/*, /messages routes are HIDDEN and redirect to /. Scenes 03,04,06,07,08,09,11 in apps/web/demo/scenes/ navigate to those dead paths and will silently land on / then time out hunting for selectors.

title: useSessionLobbyRealtime sends stale athlete name/elo in challenge payload
description: apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:28-33. currentAthleteName/currentAthleteElo feed sendChallenge (line 160) but the realtime useEffect (line 50) only depends on sessionId, router. If the user renames mid-session, outgoing challenge_sent payload uses stale name. Stash in refs (same pattern as meRef on line 41). Effort: 3 lines.

title: getNotificationPreferences silently swallows errors
description: packages/shared/src/api/mutations.ts:807-820 — only non-Result<T> read in mutations.ts. On RLS failure returns defaults indistinguishable from 'no row'. Either move to queries.ts and return Result<NotificationPrefs>, or at minimum log the error.

title: useMatchCompletion cleanup gap on terminal->non-terminal transition
description: apps/mobile/lib/match-flow/use-match-completion.ts:49-54 only returns a cleanup when matchStatus is terminal. If matchStatus transitions terminal->non-terminal (e.g. after refresh() resets state), the stale timer fires onCompleted against a now-active match. Add an else early-return or always-return cleanup. Effort: 2 lines.

title: Demo recorder crashes mid-run if videoA.saveAs throws
description: apps/web/demo/record.ts:185-198. videoA.saveAs() has no try/catch. On disk-full or flush race, loop crashes mid-run and remaining scenes leak browser contexts. Wrap saveAs in try/catch and continue.

title: Lobby uses router.replace for onMatchStarted — no back-nav on stray broadcast
description: apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:47,84,98 swapped router.push to router.replace. Any stray onMatchStarted broadcast pops the user out of the lobby with no return path. Recommend keeping push for the realtime onMatchStarted callback at minimum.

title: Mobile signup copy contradicts Supabase email-confirmation flow
description: apps/mobile/app/(auth)/signup.tsx:48,128-132 — success toast now says 'Account created' and card says 'Sign in to set up your profile'. But apps/mobile/lib/auth/auth-context.tsx:90 calls supabase.auth.signUp with no emailRedirectTo and no auto-confirm. Unless email confirmation is disabled in Supabase dashboard, sign-in will fail with 'Email not confirmed' and there is no resend affordance. Either disable confirmation in Supabase or restore 'Check your email to confirm' copy.

title: Demo: withTimeout leaks underlying Playwright work on timeout
description: apps/web/demo/record.ts:45-53. setTimeout rejection wins the race, but scene.run keeps executing (Playwright actions cannot be cancelled). Next scene's ctxA.close() may race with in-flight clicks from the prior scene -> unpredictable failures, ghost console errors, hung uploads.

title: Audit unsafe 'as unknown as' casts in queries.ts (14 sites)
description: packages/shared/src/api/queries.ts has 14 'as unknown as' sites. Lines 387-388, 967-969, 1202, 1233 cast aliased FK joins (challenger:athletes!fk(...)) through unknown — but per CLAUDE.md Principle 3, aliased joins return T directly. Removing the casts would surface latent shape mismatches.

title: Move formatElapsed and parseFinishTime to @jits/shared/utils
description: Mobile has tested implementations at apps/mobile/lib/match-flow/format-elapsed.ts and parse-finish-time.ts; the web match wizard re-implements the same mm:ss formatting inline. Tests can move with the source.

title: Unify haversineKm distance helpers across web/mobile
description: apps/web/app/(app)/session/[id]/join/steps/geo-check-step.tsx:16-26 ships an atan2-based impl; apps/mobile/lib/location/use-location.ts:65-79 ships an asin-based one. Same result but divergence is a future bug. Extract to packages/shared/src/utils/geo.ts plus GYM_PROXIMITY_THRESHOLD_KM.

title: Extract weight-validation constants to @jits/shared/utils
description: Duplicated in 4 sites: apps/web/app/(app)/session/[id]/join/steps/weight-confirm-step.tsx:17, apps/web/app/profile/setup/steps/training-step.tsx:25, apps/mobile/lib/session/validate-weight.ts:7-8, apps/mobile/lib/profile-setup/validation.ts:38-40. MIN_WEIGHT_LBS=50 / MAX_WEIGHT_LBS=400. Shared isValidWeight + constants removes drift risk.

title: README still uses JITS branding — stale
description: README.md:1,3,7,8,11,98,102 says 'JITS', jits:// scheme, jits.app universal links, and lists Beta Launch Status (2026-04-27). App is now ELO RATED, scheme elorated://, domain elorated.com (per CLAUDE.md). Phases 6/9/10 shipped 2026-05-06. Misleading for demo viewers.
